spans.s: मकमकाय [makamakāya], Den. Ā. (मकमकायते) To croak (as a frog). Kāv. मप्याततायिनम् Śukra.4.1149.

An ear-ring in the shape of a Makara.
The hands folded in the form of a Makara.
N. of one of the nine treasures of Kubera.
The tenth arc of thirty degrees in any circle. -Comp. -अङ्कः an epithet of
the ocean. -अश्वः an epithet of Varuṇa. -आकरः, -आवासः the ocean; प्रविश्य मकरावासं यादोगणनिषेवितम्

. -केतनः, -केतुः, -केतुमत् m. epithets of the god of love.

a particular medical preparation. -राशिः f. the signCapricornus of the zodiac. -वाहनः N. of Varuṇa.-संक्रमणम् the passage of the sun into the sign Capricornus. -सप्तमी the seventh day in the bright half of Māgha.
Each of the following five मद्य, मत्स्य, मांस, मैथुन and मुद्रा; see पञ्चमकार.

A kind of fragrant mango tree.
(In music) A kind of measure. -न्दम् A filament.
मकरन्दवत् [makarandavat], a. Filled with honey. -ती The Pātalā creeper or its flower.
मकरिन् [makarin], m. [मकराः सन्त्यत्र इनि] An epithet of the ocean.
मकरी [makarī], The female of a crocodile. -Comp. -पत्रम्, -लेखा the mark of a Makarī on the face of Lakṣmī.-प्रस्थः N. of a town.
मकुतिः [makutiḥ], A government order addressed to the Śūdras (शूद्रशासन).
The rod or handle of a potter's wheel.
मकुष्टः [makuṣṭḥ] मकुष्टकः [makuṣṭakḥ], मकुष्टकः A kind of kidney-bean or rice.
मकुष्ठ [makuṣṭha], a. Slow. -ष्ठः A kind of kidney-bean or rice.
मक्कलः [makkalḥ], A dangerous kind of abscess in the abdomen (of lying-in women).
A multitude, collection. -Comp. -वीर्यः the tree पियाल.

माकन्दः [mākandḥ], The mango tree; माकन्द न प्रपेदे मधुपेन तवोपमा जगति
N. of a city on the Ganges.

माकर [mākara], a. (-री f.) Belonging to the sea-monster, Makara q. v. -री N. of the seventh day in the bright half of Māgha; तन्मे रोगं च शोकं च माकरी हन्तु सप्तमी Tithyādi. -Comp. -आकरः the sea. -आसनम् a particular posture in sitting. -व्यूहः a particular form of military array.
माकरन्द [mākaranda], a. (-न्दी f.) Derived from, relating to, the juice of flowers; full of or mixed with honey; प्रचलित इव सान्द्रो माकरन्दः परागः
माकलिः [mākaliḥ], 1 N. of Mātali, the charioteer of Indra.
माकारध्यानम् [mākāradhyānam], A particular method of abstract meditation.
माक्षि [mākṣi] क्षी [kṣī] क [k], (क्षी) क a. (-की f.) Coming or derived from a bee. -कम् [माक्षिकाभिः संभृत्य कृतम् अण्]
A kind of honeylike mineral substance; माक्षीकधातुमधुपारदलोहचूर्ण Rāja. T.
honey-comb. -जम् bees'-wax. -धातुः pyrites. -फलः a kind of cocoa-nut. -शर्करा candied sugar.
